run_MessageTest_tests: run the MessageTest unittest suite to verify protobuf message parsing and serialization against golden data
test_GoldenMessage_parsing: test parsing a golden protobuf message and verify all fields are set correctly after deserialization
test_PickleSupport_serialization: test pickling and unpickling a protobuf message to verify round-trip equality
test_sorting_repeated_fields: test sorting repeated scalar and composite fields using default and custom comparators
test_ParsingMerge_behavior: test merge behavior when required or optional fields appear multiple times in parsed input
